When you register and join the LinkedIn Services, you become a “Member”. Website https://www.digrobotics.com/ Industry Agriculture, Construction, Mining Machinery Manufacturing Company size 2-10 employees Headquarters Nir Am Type Privately Held Founded 2023 Specialties Machine Learning, AI, Computer Vision, Motion Planning, ML, Mining, Construction, Earthmoving, Excavation, Operator Training, Efficiency, Productivity, Performance, GHG Emissions, Cost, Reliability, Safety, Truck Match, Fleet Optimization, and Civil Construction Employees at Dig Robotics Oded Medina LinkedIn Member LinkedIn Member LinkedIn Member LinkedIn Member LinkedIn Member View 9 employees at Dig Robotics Sign in or By clicking Continue to join or sign in, you agree to LinkedIn’s User Agreement, Privacy Policy, and Cookie Policy. See all employees Locations Primary Nir Am, IL Get directions Kfar Qasem, Industrial Park Lev Haaretz Kfar Qasem, Central District 4881000, IL Get directions Updates Dig Robotics 3,015 followers 1w Our experts powering up for Trimble Dimensions 2026! 🚜🔥 This year, there are plenty of ways to experience Dig Robotics in action: 👋 Meet our experts Come meet the Dig Robotics team, Noam Rotem and Ken G., chat about smart excavation, AI and productivity. 🎯 See Dig Robotics live Watch an excavator equipped with the Dig Robotics system load a truck in real time. See how AI optimizes every bucket, maximizes truck load, and helps improve productivity. 🎤 Join our two sessions: One is: "Dig™ Robotics is Super-Powering Excavation", in which Ken G. will explore how motion planning, computer vision and AI can turn every excavation cycle into an opportunity to improve performance. Also, we'll be giving a 5-minute session under the framework of the 0-60 Trimble Dimensions Challenge. 💫 Session No: C-1147 📅 Tuesday, November 10 | 8:30–9:30 AM PST 📍 Galileo 1002 See you there! #TrimbleDimensions #DigRobotics #ConstructionTechnology #ConstructionAI #Excavation #HeavyEquipment #Earthmoving #ConTech …more Play Video 8 Like Comment Share Dig Robotics 3,015 followers 3w It’s pretty cool when someone attends your webinar and then writes an insightful article about it. 🙌 David Arminas, Deputy Editor of Global Highways, joined a Dig Robotics webinar and came away with a great recap of the discussion, and, more importantly, some of the interesting concepts behind our approach to AI and excavation, and the expertise of our guest, Jeff Gray. 🚜 Operator assistance, not operator replacement. AI shouldn’t take control away from the person in the cab. It should help skilled operators perform closer to their best, more consistently, throughout the shift. 🪣 Small improvements, repeated thousands of times, matter. Optimizing bucket angle, stroke length, digging depth and fill can reduce unnecessary force and help move more material in less time. ⛽ Efficiency goes beyond productivity. Using less unnecessary force can mean lower fuel consumption and less unnecessary stress and wear on the machine. 🧠 AI can also become a real-time coach. Operators get the best feedback while they’re actually working, allowing them to adjust on the next cycle rather than reviewing performance hours or days later. Thanks, David, for joining us and for capturing the conversation so well. Full article at https://lnkd.in/dUJJqMQx #DigRobotics #ConstructionAI #Excavation #HeavyEquipment #Earthmoving #OperatorAssistance #ConstructionTechnology 3 Like Comment Share Dig Robotics 3,015 followers 3w Dig Robotics has officially made it onto the CICA - World Construction Association - Global ConTech and PropTech Map! 😊🎉 Turns out, if you dig smart enough, you get to great places... 🚜 We’re happy to be joining a global lineup of innovators shaping where construction technology goes next 🎇 and we'll definitely keep on digging... Check out Dig Robotics on the CICA map: https://lnkd.in/dsZR7q2Y https://lnkd.in/ezNMppUZ #ConTech #ConstructionTechnology #ConstructionAI #HeavyEquipment #Earthmoving #DigRobotics …more Play Video 9 Like Comment Share Dig Robotics 3,015 followers 3w ⛏️ One of our favorite moments after installing a Dig Robotics system on a new customer’s excavator is reviewing the Site Manager performance report with them. 📊 For the first time, they’re not looking at estimates/averages - they know what actually happened, down in the pit, at the individual bucket pass and truck load. 🚛 For every truck, we can answer questions like: 📦 How much material was actually loaded into the truck bed? ⏱️ How long did the loading take? 🔢 How many bucket passes did it take to load the truck? 🪣 What was the bucket fill factor for each pass? 🔄 How long did each excavation cycle take? 📈 How did performance change throughout the shift? 🤔 Sometimes it takes a moment for the customer to realize the level of visibility they now have, and the first reaction is: “There’s no way you can measure that. Prove it.” Then, sure enough, the conversation quickly changes to: “What else can you tell me?” 🚛 Why was that haul truck only 70% full? ⏱️ Why did excavator cycle time increase during this part of the shift? 📉 Why did production drop for 20 minutes? ⏳ Was the excavator waiting for trucks? 🔍 Was the problem bucket fill, truck availability, haul-cycle variation? 🕐 Can we identify exactly when it started? 🔁 Can we see whether it happens every shift? ➕ More. More. More... 🎯 And that’s exactly where we want the conversation to go. #DigRobotics #ExcavationAnalytics #ConstructionTechnology #MiningTechnology #HeavyEquipment #Earthmoving #Excavation

jobs.description: Skip to main content KHL Group Book and Periodical Publishing Wadhurst, East Sussex 10,101 followers Follow View all 167 employees About us Established in 1989, KHL Group is the leading supplier of international construction information in the world. KHL Group is a diversified media company and the leading global supplier of international construction and power information with offices in eleven countries around the world. It has achieved rapid growth through market focus and an intense knowledge of the world market. Editorial quality and independence from commercial pressures is why KHL's magazines enjoy a loyal readership. In 2010 KHL Group won the prestigious Queen’s Award for International Enterprise. KHL Group, acquired the USA-based publisher Diesel & Gas Turbine Publication Group on February 1st, 2018. Founded in 1935, Wisconsin, USA-based Diesel & Gas Turbine Publication Group (D>P) is the leading and most-respected publisher of information for the on-highway, off-highway, stationary and marine engine-powered equipment markets. It focuses on the construction and agriculture, power generation and commercial vehicle equipment sectors through its North American magazine, Diesel Progress and globally through Diesel Progress International. Off-Highway Research is KHL Group’s specialist market intelligence arm. Formed in 1981 as part of The Economist Intelligence Unit (EIU), Off-Highway Research is a management consultancy specialising in the research and analysis of international construction, and agricultural equipment markets, and is the largest of its kind in the world. The company is staffed by industry specialists with a wide range of industry, language and consultancy skills, and is supported by a unique database of information. KHL is the largest and most respected provider of international construction information in the world.
